notes.title: FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake 3.0.1 update is now live!
notes.notes:
FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake 3.0.1 update is now live!

[list]
[*] Fixed input issues when connecting a gamepad while the Pause Menu is open.
[*] Resolved problems with selecting a New Game+ save.
[*] Supply trucks now properly heal friendly units.
[*] Addressed Wanzer spawning on occupied fields in Mercenaries single-player missions.
[*] Fixed a lobby bug in PvP Two Controllers where dialogs remained visible after disconnecting the gamepad and exiting to the main menu.
[*] Additional minor fixes and upgrades.
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!

notes.title: Mercenaries Content Update is here!
notes.notes:
A new multiplayer update to FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake is here!
Free Content Update – Mercenaries, contains local multiplayer mode, single player scenario, new maps, and more!


The Mercenaries update is now live - download the latest version to enjoy the new content!


[previewyoutube=4P4TgRAAE4c;full][/previewyoutube]

Mercenaries Content Update includes:

- New Singleplayer Scenarios
An exciting array of six new singleplayer scenarios is coming with the update. Each scenario is carefully crafted to offer a diverse range of challenges and engaging narratives. These new missions provide a captivating solo gaming experience while also expanding gameplay with new types of terrain tiles.

- Local Multiplayer Mode
Jump into action with the local multiplayer mode using two controllers or the hot-seat functionality! Challenge your friends to a skirmish and prove your tactical superiority on brand-new maps.

- Six New Maps
Buried Factory, Leaves of the Fallen, Porunta’s Hideaway, and three more maps to be unlocked as you progress, will serve as arenas for single-player scenarios and multiplayer skirmishes.

- New Mercenaries and a Commander Character
Meet 15 new playable characters and the commander, who introduce you to the new update and assemble the best possible team.

And more!

notes.title: Free content update is coming to FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake in 2024!
notes.notes:
We have exciting news for FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake fans!
The game is receiving a free Content Update - Mercenaries, featuring hot-seat local multiplayer, single-player scenarios, and more!


This Content Update is scheduled for 2024 - stay tuned for upcoming news!


Mercenaries Content Update:

- New Singleplayer Scenarios
An exciting array of fresh singleplayer scenarios is coming with the update, each carefully crafted to provide a diverse range of challenges and engaging narratives. These new missions bring a captivating solo gaming experience while also expanding gameplay with new types of terrain tiles.

- Local Multiplayer Hot-Seat Mode
Jump into action with local multiplayer mode featuring hot-seat functionality! Challenge your friends to a skirmish and prove your tactical superiority on brand-new maps.

- New Mercenaries and a Commander Character
Meet a whole new character roster, including the commander a character, whose role is to introduce you to the new update and assemble the best possible team of mercenaries.

And more!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.notes:
A new batch of fixes for FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake is now live on Steam - make sure your game is up to date!

See the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Improved controls on the world map
[*] Ability to use WASD and mouse dragging for navigation.
[*] Scroll in the setup menu should now be visible for all resolutions.
[*] Fixed softlocks in QuickCombat.
[*] Changed the conditions for the "WHATEVER THE COMMAND MAY BE" achievement
(the achievement can now also be obtained by eliminating all enemies).
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed multiple completions of Extra Mission 2 with OCU.
[*] Fixed a camera glitch that caused camera jumps on the map for 21:9 aspect ratio.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello, Front Mission fans!

Thank you for playing FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake!

Thanks to your feedback and involvement, we were able to prepare the first post-launch patch for you!

Today, we're bringing you an update that fixes reported bugs and improves general QoL on Steam.

Please find the complete list of changes below: ⬇

- Fixed bugs related to quick load and quick save functions.
- Fixed the issue of randomly unlocking progressive achievements.
- The mouse can now be used to select chaff targets.
- The achievement "Safe Return" can now be unlocked.
- Fixed the world map bug in the U.S.N. campaign.
- Added rain effect to maps.
- Added missing vegetation on the OCU22 map.
- Various minor fixes.

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!
